title: App Icon
slide_intent: Judge two related icons at their actual point of choice on a phone.
strategic_value: Comparing both changes in context can reveal whether the main and shopper apps remain distinguishable.
demonstration: Two cropped phone screens show paired Instacart and Shopper icons under Version 1.0 and Version 2.0 labels.
practical_value: Compare the neighboring primary and shopper icons in each version before selecting artwork for a launcher.

content_islands.name: Version 1.0 preview
content_islands.spec: Use the left dark field for a large crop of the phone’s upper corner and the two original icons.

content_islands.name: Version 2.0 preview
content_islands.spec: Mirror the crop on a pale field at right, holding the arrangement steady while swapping icon artwork.
